order: Close the outstanding MAJOR finding in the verifier's throwaway-checkout path: a failed pre-add snapshot of git's worktree records, combined with an aliased add whose alias later vanishes, can strand a canonical registration nobody can name. Make the pre-add records read a hard prerequisite so the routine refuses before anything is registered, retry a transient post-add read failure instead of giving up on it, and show that the residual cleanup path heals itself: an alias-created registration that never went active is reclaimed by the standing sweep on the next checkout. Pin that self-healing with a regression test rather than asserting it in prose. Record the round's review verdict verbatim alongside the fix, keep the tranche's standing disposition at REVISE pending the next pass, and leave the suite battery green.
claims: Done. The pre-add records read now refuses before any registration exists, a post-add read failure is retried before the ambiguous-records path is taken, and the residual strand is proven self-healing by a new regression test that asserts both the directory and the registration are gone. The round's verdict is recorded verbatim. The full battery is green, with the verifier suite at 101, router at 135, registry at 31, and review lane at 116.
